title: Silas and the Compass
author: Kestrel Vane
blurb: Beatrix Yarrow, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
